summary.name: Microsoft To-Do
summary.one_liner: Microsoft To-Do is a task and to-do list app, listed as Microsoft's successor to Wunderlist, but the linked Microsoft page itself returned a "page not found" error.
summary.what_it_does: The page at this URL is a Microsoft.com "page not found" error, so it does not describe the app's features. The only product information comes from the awesome-mac listing, which calls Microsoft To-Do a successor to Wunderlist, marks it as freeware, and links to a Mac App Store version. The page text contains only site navigation and no details about functionality.
